Class ParamsRequestCondition

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.web.reactive.result.condition.AbstractRequestCondition<ParamsRequestCondition>
org.springframework.web.reactive.result.condition.ParamsRequestCondition
All Implemented Interfaces:
RequestCondition<ParamsRequestCondition>
public final class ParamsRequestCondition extends AbstractRequestCondition<ParamsRequestCondition>
逻辑与 (`' && ')` 请求条件，用于根据在RequestMapping.params()中定义的语法将请求与一组参数表达式进行匹配。
Since:
5.0
Author:
Rossen Stoyanchev

    • getToStringInfix

      protected String getToStringInfix()
      描述从类复制：AbstractRequestCondition
      The notation to use when printing discrete items of content.

      例如，URL 模式使用 `" || "`，参数表达式使用 `" && "`。

    • compareTo

      public int compareTo(ParamsRequestCondition other, ServerWebExchange exchange)
      Compare to another condition based on parameter expressions. A condition is considered to be a more specific match, if it has:
      1. 更多的表达式。
      2. 具有具体值的非否定表达式数量更多。

      假定这两个实例均通过 `getMatchingCondition(ServerWebExchange)` 获取，且每个实例仅包含匹配的参数表达式或为空。
